title: Creamy Tuscan Chicken
conventions: buy strings are cook measures (what goes in the pot), grams derived FROM the printed measure via db\densities.json (or the flagged USDA unit weights where densities has no row) so the two agree by construction; quantities quantized to house quarters, drift from the exact 3.5x scale noted per line where it exceeds 5%.

ingredients.notes: Main protein on a COUNT, so the each-weight is the danger line (florentine failure mode). Booked at the house densities each = 200 g -> 800 g source batch = 200 g raw per serving. The source's own published protein arbitrates: 42 g/serving implies ~173 g chicken/serving (non-chicken lines supply ~3.3 g), and our 200 g recompute lands at 45.9 g protein, +9.3% vs published - inside the 15% instrument. A retail 'thin sliced' cutlet at ~113 g each would give 26.7 g (-36%, BREAK), so the small-cutlet reading is refuted by the source's own label. Catalog average is 167 g/serving; 200 g sits high but within the band the published macros support. Board 6 of 7, cheapest Baker's $1.99/lb.

macro_cross_check.verdict: PASS: protein +9.3% (inside the 15% instrument), calories +6.8%, fat +2.9%, carbs +10% - all four track the source. The gap direction is consistent with our 200 g/breast house each-weight vs the source's implied ~173 g/serving; both readings sit inside tolerance, and the alternative 113 g retail thin-cutlet reading is refuted outright (protein would compute -36% low). Nothing to re-examine.
macro_cross_check.band_check: computed 517.8 cal in [400, 650] PASS (132 cal of ceiling headroom, 118 above the floor); carbs 8.8 g <= 35 PASS (net-carb margin is not needed - total carbs already clear the gate)

board_defects_observed: ingredient-map.json legacy entry 'Spinach' -> frozen-chopped-spinach is a FRESH->FROZEN form-flip that predates the board's fresh 'spinach' commodity (now live, 7 of 7 stores). This run's mapped file bids 'spinach' (fresh); but update-recipes-db.ps1 stamps item_id from ingredient-map.json FIRST, so at spec/stamp time the item name 'Spinach' would be overridden back to frozen-chopped-spinach. Needs a map correction through the match-soundness gate BEFORE this recipe's stamp pass; the macro side is unaffected (fresh and frozen rows are per-gram identical), only the price class is. Not edited by this run - flagged for the registrar/gate.

Sun-Dried Tomatoes (Oil-Packed): no densities row; the existing Sun-Dried Tomatoes cup 54 / tbsp 3.5 is the DRY basis. USDA oil-packed drained cup = 110 g - propose a separate row (cup 110, tbsp 7) keyed to the new DB item.
